subject: The one feature 90% of users skip
preview_text: I almost didn't send this, but it transforms your date planning completely.
body_paragraphs: I was going to keep this to myself, but I can't. Most couples using our app miss the one thing that makes it ten times more powerful. It's like having a Ferrari and only driving it to the grocery store.

Here's the secret: the shared wishlist. You and your partner can each add date ideas you're dying to try, from a budget-friendly picnic to a fancy dinner. Then, instead of scrambling for ideas, you just pick one. It turns planning into a game of anticipation and surprise.

This isn't just a list. It's a way to show your partner you've been paying attention to what they want. When you surprise them with something from their wishlist, you're saying I listen, I care, and I'm invested in us.
Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together now and start your shared wishlist with your partner. P.S. Every time you add an idea, you both get a little dopamine hit. It's addictive in the best way.
